name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted homelab start page with a drag-and-drop grid of app shortcuts, service health checks and widgets for media, download and DNS tools.

alerts.message: Open the site right after deployment: the setup page creates the first account, which becomes the administrator. Until then anyone with the URL can claim it, and the dashboard stays readable without signing in.

The container runs without the Docker socket or host /sys, so the system monitor widget only sees what the container sees (no host temperatures or host network interfaces) and the in-app updater does not work. Update by redeploying with a newer image.
